description: Gluteal-region morphology: shape, size, projection, gluteal-fold definition, and transitions to surrounding regions. Dimensions are drawn from gluteal-aesthetic-surgery literature (Cuenca-Guerra, Mendieta, Roberts) which has produced the contemporary classification systems for buttock shape and proportions. Significant ethnic and individual variation; the Mendieta four-class system is the most-cited classification for buttock shape in plastic-surgery literature.

dimensions.scale_citation: Mendieta CG (2007). Classification system for gluteal evaluation. Clinics in Plastic Surgery, 34(3): 333-346.
dimensions.description: Four-class buttock-shape classification developed for gluteal-aesthetic surgery, based on the silhouette from a posterior view.

values.definition: Wider at the lower buttock; trapezoidal silhouette with the wider edge inferior.
Wider at the upper buttock; trapezoidal silhouette with the wider edge superior.
Approximately circular silhouette; aesthetic-surgery reference shape.
Approximately rectangular silhouette with similar width across upper and lower.

dimensions.scale_citation: Aligned with gluteal-aesthetic descriptors used in body-contouring literature (Roberts TL et al. Aesthetic Surgery Journal).
dimensions.description: Overall buttock size relative to body proportions.

values.definition: Limited gluteal mass; minimal projection from the trunk silhouette.
Substantial gluteal mass; dominant feature of the trunk silhouette. Constitutional, athletic, or augmented.

dimensions.scale_citation: Aligned with gluteal-aesthetic descriptors used in lateral-view-based aesthetic assessment.
dimensions.description: Posterior projection of the buttock from the sacral plane in lateral view.

values.definition: Pronounced posterior projection; 'shelf-like' silhouette in lateral view.

observability.notes: Best assessed from lateral view; frontal view alone cannot resolve projection.

dimensions.scale_citation: Aligned with descriptors used in gluteal-aesthetic-surgery literature on the gluteal-thigh transition.
dimensions.description: Sharpness of the gluteal fold (the crease between the buttock and the posterior thigh).

values.definition: Clear, crisp gluteal fold as a discrete landmark.
Gradual buttock-to-thigh transition; reduced fold definition.

dimensions.scale_citation: Aligned with descriptors used in gluteal-augmentation literature on lateral hip morphology.
dimensions.description: Visible depression at the lateral hip ('hip dip' / 'violin hip') between the iliac crest and the greater trochanter.

values.definition: Smooth lateral hip silhouette without visible depression.

dimensions.scale_citation: Aligned with descriptors used in BBL (Brazilian Butt Lift) aesthetic literature.
dimensions.description: Relationship between buttock width and hip width in the posterior silhouette.

values.definition: Buttock projection substantially wider than waist creating an hourglass posterior silhouette.

dimensions.scale_citation: Aligned with surgical-gynecology and gluteal-aesthetic descriptors of bilateral asymmetry.

references: Mendieta CG (2007). Classification system for gluteal evaluation. Clinics in Plastic Surgery, 34(3): 333-346.

Cuenca-Guerra R, Quezada J (2004). What makes buttocks beautiful? A review and classification of the determinants of gluteal beauty and the surgical techniques to achieve them. Aesthetic Plastic Surgery, 28(5): 340-347.
Roberts TL III, Toledo LS, Badin AZ (2001). Augmentation of the buttocks by micro fat grafting. Aesthetic Surgery Journal, 21(4).
